title: Creating Opportunity for Youth to Thrive
what_it_is: Creating Opportunity for Youth to Thrive

sections.label: Redefining success for youths
sections.summary: The Prime Minister released a video on redefining success in Singapore beyond the 5Cs, citing mentors, different pathways and different aspirations.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Recently, on redefining success for youths, the hon Prime Minister released a video on redefining success in Singapore beyond the proverbial 5Cs.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: He spoke of having had the benefit of mentors, a need to recognise that people flourish at different times, that there are different pathways to success, and that there should be room for different skills, aptitudes and talents, as well as different aspirations, priorities and hopes.

sections.label: Reassuring youths on opportunity cost
sections.summary: The speaker cautions that youths must be reassured the opportunity cost of side steps and experimentation is not insurmountable.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: To hear it from the office of the Prime Minister is reassuring.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: However, I would caution that at the last mile, it is important to address and reassure the youths, that as they try to follow their heart and curate their own pathway of success, and, if it so happens that they do not find themselves in the proverbial 5C boxes, that the opportunity cost of that side step and experimentation is not insurmountable.

sections.label: Students' abilities versus confidence
sections.summary: Students topped Mathematics, Reading, Science and Creative Thinking, but their self-confidence was below the OECD average and not commensurate with their strengths.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Relevant to us specifically, our students have attained pole position in terms of Mathematics, Reading and Science and, this round, we also topped the matrices for Creative Thinking.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: What is striking though is that despite our articulated strong ability and high levels of creative thinking, the same press release also noted that there is a dissonance in our students' objective measured abilities versus their belief and confidence in their abilities and own creativity.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: In essence, even though we topped the class or the cohort internationally, the level of self-confidence we have in ourselves is captured as being less than the OECD average, and not commensurate with the strengths that we have.

sections.label: Adjournment Motion on youth opportunity
sections.summary: The Adjournment Motion speaks to how the Government must create opportunity for youths to thrive.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: In closing, Mr Speaker, my Adjournment Motion speaks to how the Government must create opportunity for youths to thrive in our midst.

sections.label: Expanding youth opportunities abroad
sections.summary: The speaker asks whether MTI, MFA, MOM, MSF and MCCY could expand collaboration, permissive employment policies and community support for youths overseas.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: For example, when the Ministry of Trade and Industry and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs engage our overseas counterparts diplomatically, could we be more deliberate in expanding areas of collaboration specific for our youth base to thrive and find opportunities, too, especially in emerging markets, such as the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN), India, China, the Middle East and perhaps, even in less chartered pathways, in Africa and South America?

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Could perhaps the Ministry of Manpower's policies be more permissive to support employment efforts for youths to do side steps and nudge employers to consider youth development in other areas and yet find a way that it could also be sustainable for businesses in the longer term?

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: And would, perhaps, MSF and MCCY consider community and social support for our youths who may come from underprivileged families, to afford them some stability, assuage their concerns and lend them confidence to still push ahead, to take that leap for an overseas internship, apprenticeship or work opportunity?

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: In the spirit of youthful exuberance, Mr Speaker, where there are opportunities to be had, where the step is pragmatic and where the floor of support is reasonable and reassuring, most youths would leap at half a chance to give it a go.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: It is my firm belief that, if we do it right, it is possible for our youths to flourish, compete, give of their best and thrive, grazing in the pastures of the world, yet remain rooted here in this little red dot we call home.

sections.label: Expanding Outward Bound Singapore
sections.summary: OBS, attended by over 20,000 Secondary 3 students yearly, is being expanded to 40,000 participants a year once OBS@Coney is completed.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: OBS, which over 20,000 Secondary 3 students attend every year, equips them to be confident, resilient and rugged.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: We are expanding OBS to double the number of participants to 40,000 a year, once OBS@Coney is completed later this year.

sections.label: Finance training for polytechnic students
sections.summary: Training and career opportunities in finance are provided for youths through schemes with MAS, IBF and OCBC.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: We also provide training and career opportunities for our youths in the financial sector.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: We launched the Polytechnic Talent for Finance Scheme last year together with the Monetary Authority of Singapore and the Institute of Banking and Finance to offer internships and apprenticeships for polytechnic students, leading to full-time jobs in the financial industry.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: Just last month, we partnered OCBC to launch OCBC Ignite, an internship and apprenticeship programme to equip polytechnic students with industry experience and skills to springboard their career to a university graduate-equivalent role in 18 months.

sections.label: Partners for disadvantaged youths
sections.summary: For disadvantaged youths, work is done with partners including MSF and youth sector organisations like Access.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: For disadvantaged youths, we work with many different partners, including at the Ministry of Social and Family Development (MSF), but also with youth sector organisations like Access, a social mobility charity providing career exposure opportunities for our youths.

sections.label: Youth Corps Singapore service opportunities
sections.summary: Youth Corps Singapore equips youths and provides opportunities to serve in areas such as sustainability and vulnerable groups.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: Like through Youth Corps Singapore, which equips our youths and provides opportunities for them to serve in a myriad of areas such as sustainability and caring for vulnerable groups.

sections.label: Equipping youths to thrive
sections.summary: The response states the best thing for youths as a nation is equipping them with tools to thrive in a changing world.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: In my response, I have made the point that the best thing we can do for our youths as a nation is to equip them with the tools to thrive in a world in flux.
